en.headline: Chu takes omnium silver as sailors medal in Nagoya
en.dek: Chu Tsun-wai scored 166 points for men's omnium silver, while Hong Kong also took silver and bronze in the skiff events on Thursday.
body: Hong Kong added a track-cycling silver and two sailing medals at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Thursday, on top of the Madison silver and men's team squash bronze already recorded earlier in the day.

Chu Tsun-wai took silver in the men's omnium with 166 points. Sing Tao reported that Japan's Kanta Umezawa won gold with 193. Chu led after the scratch race, slipped to second after the elimination, and held that place in the points race. He told Sing Tao the medal made up for missing the podium in the team pursuit, and that his father was in the stands.

In sailing, Tiffany Mak and Polson Emily Grace took silver in the women's 49erFX skiff, and Sakai Akira Luke and Aylsworth Russell Williams took bronze in the men's 49er, the government said. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law congratulated the sailors and said Chu had kept his advantage through a tight race.

Law said Thursday's haul was three silvers and two bronzes across track cycling, sailing and squash. The Madison silver for Lee Sze-wing and Leung Wing-yee, and the men's squash team bronze, had already been reported separately.

zh.headline: 朱浚瑋全能賽摘銀 帆船再添一銀一銅
zh.dek: 朱浚瑋在名古屋亞運男子全能賽以166分奪銀；女子49erFX得銀，男子49er得銅。
body: 港隊周四在名古屋亞運再添場地單車一面銀牌及帆船一銀一銅，早前已報道的女子麥迪遜銀牌及男子壁球團體銅牌未計在這次新添的成績內。
朱浚瑋在男子全能賽以166分奪得銀牌。星島日報報道，日本梅澤幹太以193分奪金。朱浚瑋在捕捉賽暫列首位，淘汰賽後跌至次名，記分賽守住第二。他向星島表示，這面個人首面亞運獎牌算是彌補團體追逐賽未能登台的遺憾，父親亦在場觀看。
帆船方面，政府新聞處表示，Tiffany Mak與Polson Emily Grace在女子雙人小艇49erFX奪銀，Sakai Akira Luke與Aylsworth Russell Williams在男子49er奪銅。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩祝賀運動員，並說朱浚瑋在激烈競爭中保持優勢奪銀。
羅淑佩說，港隊周四在場地單車、帆船及壁球合共取得三銀兩銅。李思穎與梁穎儀的麥迪遜銀牌，以及男子壁球團體銅牌，早前已另行報道。
